whoosh-medium-soft.name: Whoosh, medium and soft
whoosh-medium-soft.description: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.
use_for: Panels sliding in
Gentle card reveals
Backgrounds shifting
Calm transitions between explainer scenes

sync.how: Ease-in-out: put the sync point at the middle of the move. Ease-out (fast start, slowing to a stop): about a quarter of the way in. Ease-in (slow start, fast exit): about three quarters of the way in.

adapt.notes: To fit a move up to about 15% shorter or 20% longer, play it faster or slower (its pitch moves with it); beyond that, use the next speed. Adjust level with gain, but for a clearly softer or harder sound use the other intensity rather than a big gain change.

pairs_with.how: Something landing: the whoosh on the move (its sync point at the move's fastest point) and the impact on the frame it lands. A whoosh that suits the move's length dies away just before the landing; use one a step softer than the impact.
Something arriving and appearing: the whoosh during the move, the pop as it lands, at a lower gain than the whoosh.
A reveal: the whoosh into the reveal, the shimmer starting at the whoosh's sync point.

whoosh-slow-medium.name: Whoosh, slow and medium
whoosh-slow-medium.description: A slow, full sweep of air with a gentle swell and a long, settled tail.
use_for: Large panels or maps sliding
Slow pans across a scene
Deliberate reveals

sync.how: Ease-in-out: put the sync point at the middle of the move. Ease-out (fast start, slowing to a stop): about a quarter of the way in. Ease-in (slow start, fast exit): about three quarters of the way in.

adapt.notes: To fit a move up to about 15% shorter or 20% longer, play it faster or slower (its pitch moves with it); beyond that, use the next speed. Adjust level with gain, but for a clearly softer or harder sound use the other intensity rather than a big gain change.

swipe-medium-soft.name: Swipe, medium and soft
swipe-medium-soft.description: A soft fingertip swipe across a screen.
use_for: Swiping a card across in an app demo
Moving between tabs or pages
Swipe-to-unlock and swipe-to-confirm
avoid_for: Objects flying through the air (use a whoosh or swish)
Moments that need to cut through music (use firm)

sync.how: Start it as the finger starts to move; the hiss is quickest early on, like a flick, and stops as the finger lifts.

adapt.notes: Pick the nearest speed, then change the rate a little to match the gesture.

pairs_with.how: A screen sliding away after the swipe: the swipe as the finger moves, then a soft fast whoosh on the screen's move.
Swiping and then tapping: the swipe, a short gap, then a tap.

riser-2s-soft.name: Riser, 2 s, soft
riser-2s-soft.description: A 2-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.
use_for: Building up to a reveal: a logo, a product, a big number
Leading into a new section
A short lift before something appears
avoid_for: Reveals that land before the rise ends: the peak is at its end

sync.how: Place it so its end (the sync point) lands on the reveal: start = reveal − sync.at.

adapt.notes: For other lengths, change the rate a little (its pitch moves with it), or take the next longer one and trim its quiet start (risers) or its quiet end (fallers).

pairs_with.how: A reveal with weight: the rise into an impact on the reveal frame.
A bright reveal: the rise into a shimmer starting at its sync point.
A big reveal: the rise into a boom on the reveal frame.

cinematic-drum-big.name: Cinematic drum hit, big
cinematic-drum-big.description: A giant drum struck hard: the crack of the stick and a big, deep boom.
use_for: Title slams and trailer beats
A logo or product landing with force
Dramatic reveals
Big moments: a title, a reveal, a turning point
avoid_for: On top of speech: the bass masks it

sync.how: Sync point on the frame of the hit: the title landing, the cut, the reveal. Let the hall ring out.

adapt.notes: Slower sounds bigger and deeper; faster tighter. To shorten one, fade its tail over 500 ms or more.

pairs_with.how: A pull into the hit: the reverse whoosh's stop on the hit's sync point.
A built-up hit: a strong riser whose end meets the hit.

bass-sub-drop-short.name: Sub drop, short
bass-sub-drop-short.description: A short sub drop: a deep tone dropping away, about a second.
use_for: The moment after a build: a reveal, a logo or a big statement
Scene changes and title cards with weight
The bottom dropping out
avoid_for: On top of speech: its low end masks it

sync.how: Sync point on the frame of the reveal, the beat or the hit (it's at the very start).

adapt.notes: For other lengths, pick the nearest and fade its tail out over 300 ms or more.

pairs_with.how: A built-up reveal: the riser's end on the sync point.
A hit with bass: a heavy or deep impact on the same frame, the bass at −3 dB.

boom-hit-medium.name: Boom hit, medium
boom-hit-medium.description: A deep, rounded boom with a warm hall.
use_for: A title card or logo landing with weight
A big statement or a key number
A scene change with impact
avoid_for: On top of speech: its low end masks it

sync.how: Sync point on the frame of the reveal or the landing (it's at the very start). Leave the tail to ring out: the hall is part of it.

adapt.notes: Slower sounds deeper and longer; faster lighter. For a shorter boom, fade the tail out over 300 ms or more rather than cutting it.

pairs_with.how: A built-up reveal: the riser's end on the boom's sync point.
A pull into a big moment: the reverse whoosh's stop on the boom's sync point.
A big, bright reveal: the boom with a shimmer starting with it at −4 dB.

boom-hit-soft.description: A soft, deep boom: a big drum struck gently in a hall.

foley-paper-slide.name: Paper slide
foley-paper-slide.description: Paper sliding across a desk: a soft, dry hiss.
use_for: Documents, letters and invoices appearing
Pages turning or notes being handled
Paperwork and forms
Something sliding into or across the frame

sync.how: Start it with the move; its level follows a natural speed curve (fastest in the middle), so it suits an ease-in-out move of about the same length.

adapt.notes: To fit a longer or shorter move, change the rate a little; beyond that, fade the end.

pairs_with.how: Something physical moving quickly: a soft whoosh with the slide at −6 dB, or the touch on the landing.
Something heavier set down: a light impact with the touch for the material's texture.

tone-ding-low.name: Ding, low
tone-ding-low.description: A small bell's clear ding (G, low).
use_for: Highlighting a key point, a feature or a benefit
A tick, an answer or a result appearing
An idea: the lightbulb moment

sync.how: Sync point on the frame the highlight appears.

adapt.notes: Don't change the rate: it detunes the note.

pairs_with.how: A brighter highlight: the ding with a short soft shimmer starting with it at −4 dB.

tone-step-1.name: Step 1 of 5
tone-step-1.description: Step 1 of 5: a soft marimba note (C), each one higher.
use_for: Words, lines or list items appearing one by one: step 1 for the first, 2 for the second…
Bullet points and checklists building up
Icons or cards appearing in a row
avoid_for: Items appearing all at once (use a single pop)
Lists longer than five: there are five steps

sync.how: Sync point on the frame each item appears; use the steps in order.

adapt.notes: Don't change the rate: it detunes the note.

pairs_with.how: Items popping in: the pop for each item and its step on top at −3 dB.

shimmer-long-soft.name: Shimmer, long, soft
shimmer-long-soft.description: A long shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.
use_for: Gentle highlights: a feature, a benefit, a tick
Elements lighting up or being highlighted
A slow, lingering reveal

sync.how: Sync point near the start: put it on the frame the highlight or reveal appears; the shimmer trails after.

adapt.notes: Don't change the rate: it detunes the glints. For a shorter shimmer, fade the end; for longer, use the next length.

pairs_with.how: A built-up reveal: the rise into the reveal, the shimmer starting at the rise's end.
Something appearing with delight: the pop as it appears, the shimmer starting with it at −4 dB.
A reveal after a move: the whoosh into it, the shimmer starting at the whoosh's sync point.
